installbench-dind-entrypoint
TRAILING_SLASH=off
# NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN=your-domain.com
# NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_ANALYTICS_URL=https://plausible.io/your-domain.com# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# Development image for Next.js with Yarn v1
# Uses node:22-alpine. Yarn v1 is not bundled with the Node image and Corepack
# defaults to Yarn v4, so we install Yarn 1.22.22 globally via npm.
# NOTE: yarn.lock was accidentally dropped on main in fcdbaca and is restored
# on this branch; installs are deterministic again (--frozen-lockfile).

FROM node:22-alpine

WORKDIR /app

RUN npm install -g yarn@1.22.22 --force

# Install dependencies first (better layer caching), as non-root user.
# WORKDIR /app is root-owned; chown it before switching users.
COPY package.json yarn.lock ./
RUN chown -R node:node /app
USER node
RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile --network-timeout 300000

# Copy remaining source (node_modules/build dirs are excluded via .dockerignore)
COPY --chown=node:node . .

# Expose Next.js dev port
EXPOSE 3000

# Bind to 0.0.0.0 so the port is reachable from the Docker host
ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0

CMD ["yarn", "dev", "--hostname", "0.0.0.0", "--webpack"]

observation.command: which node npm yarn corepack 2>&1; ls /usr/local/bin | head -50; cat /workspace/.env.example; cat /workspace/Dockerfile
